long_biography.plain_text:
Kulczyk Holding became one of the private engines of Poland's post-communist economic transformation. Under Jan Kulczyk, it built the country's largest automotive distribution group, co-founded Kompania Piwowarska and led the consortium behind Poland's first private toll motorway. Stakes in telecommunications, insurance and energy turned the family platform into a diversified investment house.

In 2007, he recast the business as Kulczyk Investments, pursuing resources, power and infrastructure projects across more than thirty countries. His children moved into leadership before his death, while he remained the group's strategic figure. Beyond business, Kulczyk supported culture and scholarship; his gift to Warsaw's POLIN Museum enabled completion of its core exhibition and became the museum's largest private donation.
